correctness.rationale: Recomputed the BDF3 coefficients directly from four-node cubic Lagrange interpolation, the two companion matrices, and their reduced quadratic z^2-T(r)z+E(r). The three scaled Schur-Jury expressions equal strictly positive coefficient polynomials divided by Delta(r) for every r>0; endpoint limits give the unattained optimal 1/5 parasitic two-step radius. The discriminant is r^4 F(r+1/r)/Delta^2 with F(u)=u^4-22u^3-173u^2-390u-279, one root u>2 by Descartes and endpoint signs; it yields reciprocal mode-transition ratios. The eigenvalue 1 is simple, while both parasitic eigenvalues are strictly damped, implying uniform-in-step-number homogeneous zero stability for each FIXED positive alternating r. Independently recreated exact symbolic identities in independent_checks.py; finite example ratios are not the all-r proof.
